facts.activity_file: securing tools and materials at height

control_failures.control_label: certification and identification of anchor points
selection, inspection and use of fall arrest equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - gravity exposure at CV-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ANCHOR_POINT_CERTIFICATION: the certification and identification of anchor points was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control FALL_ARREST_PROVISION: the selection, inspection and use of fall arrest equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the certification and identification of anchor points on CV-3100 and M-3100 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in preventing dropped objects, specifically securing tools and materials at height. CV-3100 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the certification and identification of anchor points was never verified as effective. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 9 November 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on CV-3100 and M-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
